title: Full Trip Simulation
persona: You are a polite airline check-in agent at Istanbul Airport. The passenger is flying to Lisbon.
briefTr: Lizbon'a gidiyorsun. Otelin: {hotel}. Rezervasyon {name} adına. Havalimanından restorana kadar her şeyi İngilizce hallet.
opening: Good morning! Where are you flying today?

facts.question: Which gate did you fly from?
Which hotel did you stay at?

goals.instruction: The passenger says where they are flying.
goals.retryReply: Sorry, where are you flying to today?

goals.ask: May I see your passport, please?
goals.instruction: The passenger hands over their passport.
goals.retryReply: I'll need your passport to check you in.

goals.persona: You are a chatty, friendly taxi driver at Lisbon airport. The passenger has just landed.
goals.instruction: The passenger tells the driver which hotel to go to.
goals.successReply: No problem — it's about thirty minutes.
goals.retryReply: Sorry, which hotel are you going to?

goals.instruction: The passenger asks to pay or pays, by card or cash.
goals.retryReply: That's the fare. How would you like to pay?

goals.persona: You are a warm receptionist at the {hotel} in Lisbon.
goals.ask: Welcome to the {hotel}! Are you checking in?
goals.instruction: The guest says they have a reservation and gives a name.
goals.hint: Yes, I have a reservation under {name}.
goals.retryReply: Do you have a booking with us? Under what name?

goals.ask: Is there anything else I can help you with?
goals.instruction: The guest asks what time breakfast is.
goals.successReply: Breakfast is from 7 to 10, on the terrace.
goals.retryReply: Many guests ask about breakfast — would you like to know the time?

goals.persona: You are a cheerful waiter at Café Lisboa. The guest is eating alone tonight.
goals.instruction: The guest asks for a table.
goals.hint: Yes, a table for one, please.
goals.hintTr: Evet, tek kişilik bir masa lütfen.

goals.instruction: The guest declines and asks for the bill.
goals.hint: No, thanks. Could I get the bill, please?
goals.retryReply: Would you like anything else, or shall I bring the bill?

twists.intro: Oh — I'm afraid your flight is delayed by two hours.
twists.instruction: The flight is delayed. The passenger asks about a connection, a lounge or a meal voucher.
twists.retryReply: I'm sorry for the delay. Is there anything I can help you with?

options.reply: No connection on this ticket, so you're fine — you'll land in Lisbon this evening.

options.text: Is there a lounge I can use?
options.reply: Yes, the lounge is on the second floor.

options.text: Can I get a meal voucher?
options.reply: Of course. Here's a meal voucher for any café after security.

twists.intro: Oh — your suitcase is four kilos over the limit.
twists.instruction: The suitcase is too heavy. The passenger moves things to their carry-on, asks about the fee, or asks for a second bag.
twists.retryReply: I'm afraid it's over the limit. What would you like to do?

options.text: Can I move some things to my carry-on?
How much is the extra fee?
options.reply: It's 40 euros. I'll add it to your booking.

options.text: Can I check it as a second bag?
options.reply: Yes, you can split it into two bags.

twists.intro: Oh, there's a lot of traffic today. It might take an hour.
twists.instruction: There is heavy traffic. The passenger asks about a faster way, says it's okay, or asks about the price.
twists.retryReply: Sorry about the traffic. Is that okay?

options.reply: I know a shortcut along the river. Let's try it!

options.text: That's okay, I'm not in a hurry.
options.reply: Great, sit back and enjoy the view.
No, it's a fixed price from the airport.

twists.intro: Oh, one more thing — the airline just called. Your suitcase didn't arrive with your flight.
twists.instruction: The guest's suitcase is lost. The guest asks when it will arrive, asks for it to be delivered to the hotel, or asks what to do.
twists.retryReply: I'm so sorry. What would you like to know?

options.reply: Tomorrow morning — they'll bring it straight here.

options.text: Can they deliver it to the hotel?
options.reply: Yes, they'll deliver it here tomorrow morning.
Just fill in this short form — they'll deliver it tomorrow.

twists.intro: Just so you know, the kitchen closes in ten minutes.
twists.instruction: The kitchen is closing soon. The guest orders dessert now, asks for something quick, or says the main dish is enough.
twists.retryReply: Would you like to add anything before the kitchen closes?

options.text: Then I'll order dessert now too.
options.reply: Good thinking — one chocolate cake, coming up.
The soup is quick. I'll bring that first.

options.text: No problem, just the fish then.
options.reply: Perfect, the fish is on its way.

closing: Here's your bill. Enjoy the rest of your trip!
